videos.desc: In a park blanketed in orange leaves, a woman in a mustard coat catches falling leaves and throws them in the air; a man rakes a huge leaf pile and she runs and jumps into it, sinking in and laughing.

A woman ice-fishing on a frozen lake shivers with visible breath as she drills a hole in the ice. She holds her bare red hand over the hole, quickly pulls it back, rubs her arms, buries her chin in her scarf and hugs herself against the freezing air.

Before dawn on a rocky summit, a woman wrapped in a blanket points to a thin red stripe on the horizon. A small group with warm drinks stands facing that side of the sky as the glow grows and the sun finally rises over the sea of clouds, and they cheer with raised arms.

A woman in a red beanie and a man in a dark jacket play hide-and-seek in a foggy field by a stone wall. The man walks off into the thick fog until he disappears completely and she calls 'Where are you?', then he runs back out of the mist yelling 'Boo!' as a sheep appears nearby.

A sweating couple stands in a sun-baked white village square; the man's orange ice pop melts while he eats it, the woman fans herself with a hand fan saying how hot it is, and they both lean into the cool mist of a stone fountain.

A sweat-soaked man in blistering sun fans himself with a sheet of paper, wipes his face with a towel, pours bottled water over his head and finally spreads his arms in front of a big standing fan, ending slumped with his face against it.
A couple crouches on a frozen lake, marveling at bubbles trapped in the clear black ice and touching the surface; the woman then slides across it while the man cheers.

Two friends stand at a screened porch railing at night watching a tropical storm over the sea. Huge lightning bolts flash between the palm trees and they point at the sky, shouting and laughing at each strike.
videos.said: (upbeat music) - Whoa! - There! (thunder) (laughing) - Did you see that?

videos.desc: In a 3D-animated storm on a lake pier, a tall strong woman whips off her orange coat and stretches it over a smaller bespectacled woman carrying a picnic basket, shouting "Get under here! You're soaked! I've got you!". She shields her from the pouring rain all the way to a stone boathouse, then wraps the coat around her shoulders and hugs her.
videos.said: Get under here! You're soaked! I've got you!

videos.desc: On a narrow street after rain, people in red and black rubber boots and bright raincoats jump together into a big puddle that mirrors the blue sky. The splash sends ripples across the water while they laugh.

Heavy monsoon rain pours on a village street where paper boats float down the running gutter. Two teenagers shelter under a roof, then the girl steps out into the downpour, spreads her arms and dances, soaked and laughing, while the boy and a dog join her.

A young couple in a green field tilts their heads back to gaze at a huge blue sky with wispy clouds and tiny birds; the camera sweeps up across the clouds and they end up lying in the grass looking up.

In a snowy village street at dusk, a young couple catches a snowflake on a white mitten, tilts their heads back to catch falling snow on their tongues, then flops onto the fresh snow and lies there laughing.

A young couple sits under cherry trees in full bloom as petals rain down; fresh green buds open on a branch, a duck leads ducklings across a pond, the man peels off his jacket in the new warmth and they lie back on petal-covered grass.
A couple sits cozily by a window with mugs of tea while outside a violent storm bends a birch tree, rolls a barrel down the street and sends huge waves crashing over a harbor pier.
videos.said: [MUSIC PLAYING] Whoa! [MUSIC PLAYING] Listen to it.

videos.desc: A couple sits at a candlelit table in a rustic stone kitchen while a storm darkens the window behind them; lightning flashes and they count "one, two, three" on their fingers waiting for the boom, then throw up their hands when it hits, while their big dog hides under the table.

On a rainy shopping street, a woman pops open a big red umbrella just in time and smiles up at it as the rain patters down. A soaked man in a hood dashes over asking for room, ducks under, and the two walk off sharing the umbrella.
videos.said: Just in time. Room for me?

videos.desc: A group of friends stands at a wooden railing over the sea at dusk. One of them points at the setting sun on the horizon, and they all watch quietly as it sinks and the sky turns dark orange, clapping at the end.

On a green field with bending poplars and a windmill, a couple's hair whips around and the woman's yellow scarf is torn off and flies across the grass. Sheets on a clothesline billow wildly, and she leans her whole body against the gusts, laughing.

Two friends sled down a snowy slope past snow-covered pines, tumble laughing into a drift, then build a small snowman with a carrot nose above a snow-covered alpine village. At dusk they sit on their sleds watching the village lights come on.

A short sequence shot at the end of the day. A laughing woman in a red swimsuit sits chest-deep in a calm lagoon with the low sun blazing behind her and lighting up her wet hair. The camera drops to water level, where the sun sits just above a sand dune and lays a long band of light across the ripples, with a wooden boat moored to one side. Two red kites hang against the orange sky, then a kitesurfer skims across the shallow water in the sunlight, followed by a point-of-view shot of hands on the control bar. The last shot is a huge orange moon behind a row of wind turbines.

An illustrated clip. A thin man sits on a wooden chair at a small desk in a bare room, typing on a laptop. Through the big window in front of him the outside is bright: a yellow sun in a blue sky, a purple kite flying on a string, and a green ocean wave rolling in. His head tips back toward the sunny sky while his hands stay on the keyboard. His body then stretches further and further out of the chair toward the window until the chair tips over and he is pulled almost horizontal, hands still on the laptop, drawn toward the sunshine outside.

A short montage of outdoor moments. A big wave breaks over a wall of sand and floods a dug-out pool on the beach at sunset while people watch from the ridge; a man is washed over by the foam. Then a woman floats in a grey-green sea with raindrops hitting the water all around her. Then an empty wet road runs straight into an orange sunset over a snowy plain. Finally a woman in a white shirt and denim skirt spins barefoot and laughing on a wet mountain road in the rain, green cliffs and mist behind her.

An older man in a flat cap and a waxed green jacket stands in a line of people at a city bus stop. The pavement is dark and shining with water, puddles have collected along the kerb, and everyone in the queue is holding a black umbrella up over their head. The camera moves under his umbrella and you can see the drops running off its edge and beading on the stretched fabric while a red double-decker bus passes on the wet road behind. The clip then cuts to the same man indoors in a warm pub, stirring a cup of tea and dunking a biscuit into it.

A man with a headlamp pushes between huge elephant ear leaves in a green jungle, then the picture goes almost completely black: nothing can be seen except the white glare of his headlamp and a faint outline of his face and shirt. He crouches in the blackness beside a wet rock wall, the small beam picking out drips and stones a metre in front of him. He walks on through the black tunnel towards a bright opening at the far end, a silhouette against the light, and steps out onto a boulder in front of a wide waterfall falling into a turquoise pool, where he spreads his arms and looks up.

A steady shot filmed through an aircraft window in flight. The white wing with its upturned winglet cuts across the frame against a deep blue sky. Below it, white masses of water vapour drift past far above the ground: at first scattered puffs with fields and roads visible in the gaps between them, then thicker banks, and by the end an unbroken white layer stretching to the horizon so that the land is completely hidden and only the flat white top and the blue sky above it can be seen.

A hand tips a metal watering can over two terracotta pots of green herbs on a sunlit window sill, with trees in full leaf outside the open window. Cut to a close shot of a hand turning the knob on a sprinkler head standing in bright green grass. The sprinkler sends a tall jet of water arcing over a lawn with a stone fountain and flower beds behind. Then a girl reaches up to a hanging basket spilling pink and green foliage against a blue sky. Finally a man and two children run through the spray of a garden sprinkler, with a rainbow in the mist.
videos.said: There you go. Drink up. Up here too.

videos.desc: A group of friends crouches together in a circle on a sunlit cobbled square; a moment later everyone is running outward in every direction in front of a domed basilica, and the low sun throws a long dark shadow with sharp edges behind each runner on the pale stones.

Seen from the top of a pale sea cliff, a woman dives head first off the edge into deep blue water under a blue sky; the sea below shades from turquoise to dark blue, and one after another more people leap off the cliff and hit the blue surface, leaving rings of white foam.

Low morning sun pours through an open kitchen window over a dark worktop and a sink, with two potted herbs on the sill and rooftops beyond. A young man in a loose white shirt turns and walks down a bright hallway with a strip of sunlight across the parquet floor. He reaches the tall French windows, pushes them open and stands in the doorway as the sun floods over him. He steps out onto the small balcony, arms spread, and looks over the sunlit Paris rooftops with the sun low in a clear blue sky.

A wet cobbled street outside a Paris cafe under a grey sky. An elderly man with a white moustache, a flat cap and a beige trench coat holds his bare palm out flat to feel whether it is still raining, a folded red umbrella under his arm. Drops keep falling, so he lifts the umbrella, opens it with a snap over his head and stands under it, smiling at the camera while rain streaks past and other people pass behind him with their own umbrellas up.

A young woman stands in the pouring rain on a wet village street wearing a clear plastic rain jacket, grinning at the camera. She then appears in a bright yellow raincoat, doing up the front and pulling the hood up over her hair while rain falls around her. In the last part she stands on a seafront promenade in an orange raincoat and spotted rubber boots, grey sky above, big waves smashing over the railing behind her, and she spreads her arms wide as the wind and spray hit her.

On a flat white plain that is covered in snow to the horizon, a woman in a thick orange polar parka with a fur-trimmed hood holds a rope on a metal flagpole. A Norwegian flag climbs the pole against a deep blue sky. Two more people in the same orange parkas pull on the rope together to hoist the flag while others stand around holding mugs, a small hut on the snow behind them. The flag reaches the top and flaps in the wind above the group.

A short travel clip. A man in a beige tunic and a checked headscarf sprints up the crest of a red dune at dusk, then stands at a sandstone cliff face and touches carved figures and inscriptions cut into the rock. The clip ends at night by a campfire in the desert, under a sky thick with stars, where someone pours tea from a brass pot into his small cup and he lifts it towards the camera.

A woman in a yellow coat, striped knitted hat, scarf and mittens stands in a snowy city square in front of a white church with golden domes. She holds out a dark mitten flat in front of her and lets the falling snow land on it, leaning in to look closely at the single white crystals caught on the wool, laughing as more come down around her. At the end she turns away and walks off across the snow-covered square.

A rainy street in a Japanese city, everything in the shot somewhere between white and black. The sky is a flat grey ceiling of cloud, the wet road and the concrete buildings are grey, and the only colour is the rainbow-striped umbrella a young man in a beige coat shakes open over his head. He swaps it for a plain dark grey umbrella and walks up the middle of the shining wet road as the rain gets heavier, until four men in suits crowd together under that one grey umbrella, shoulder to shoulder in the downpour, the city behind them washed out to grey.

On a sandy beach at night under a sky full of stars and the Milky Way, with the dark sea behind, a young woman with curly hair, in a white zip hoodie and denim shorts, bends to look through a telescope on a tripod, laughing with excitement and tugging at a young man's arm. He stands barefoot in a navy polo and cream trousers, yawns widely, drops his arms, then crosses them again and stares up with a bored face. A glowing lantern and a flask sit on a blanket on the sand.

A seaside promenade in a violent storm, with a tornado twisting down from black clouds over the rough sea. A young man in a camel coat and black roll-neck walks calmly straight ahead towards the camera, holding a takeaway coffee, and takes a sip as he walks. Around him two men wrestle a pink inflatable flamingo, a woman clings to a lamp post, an umbrella and a hat fly through the air, a striped deckchair stands by the railing and waves crash over the railing.

A snowy city rooftop at dusk, seen from the viewer's seat. The viewer holds out two hands in thick cream knitted mittens towards a round metal fire pit where logs burn with bright orange flames and sparks rise into the falling snow. A smiling young man in a sheepskin jacket leans in, puts another log on the fire and sits back. Friends in puffer jackets and woolly hats sit on benches around the fire with warm mugs, and others stand and chat behind. Fairy lights, small potted pine trees and city buildings stand behind them.

A snowy clearing on a bright, frozen day. A smiling young woman in a red woolly hat, a blue down jacket, a red patterned jumper and snow boots flings snow off a shovel, then digs into the deep snow and clears more of the path. Behind her stands a small log cabin under a thick roof of snow, with icicles, a large stack of firewood, skis leaning on the wall and a red sled. A frozen lake and a line of dark pine trees lie beyond under a clear blue sky.
